items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked headings that each reveal a panel, with height motion you can reverse mid-way and panels that stay searchable while closed.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline messages for status and feedback, with a neutral surface, a colored icon and a dismiss that collapses smoothly.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert dialog
items.description: A confirmation dialog for destructive or important actions that waits for async work, and becomes a bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: all
items.title: All components
items.description: Every HextaUI component, the theme, shared libs and hooks in one install.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A box that holds its shape before media loads, shimmers while loading, fades the media in and falls back when it fails.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: File and image cards for uploads, with progress, states, actions, a full-card trigger and names that keep their extension.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: User photos with an initials fallback, status badges and stacked groups that collapse into a count.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status labels with colored dots, removable tags that slide closed and counts that roll to their new value.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A trail of links to the current page that wraps safely, mirrors in right-to-left layouts and expands collapsed segments in place.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: Chat message bubbles with variants, grouped corners, reactions and room for interactive content.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Buttons in every variant and size, with a built-in loading, success and error flow that skips the spinner for fast requests.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons joined into one control, with shared seams, separators, text addons, nesting and vertical stacks.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A date grid for single, range and multiple selection, with sliding months, range previews and touch-sized days.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface for grouping content, with three variants, edge-to-edge media, concentric radii and whole-card links.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Native scroll-snap slides with momentum on touch, mouse dragging, arrow keys, dots, thumbnails and an autoplay that pauses when it should.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts charts with themed colors, a tooltip and legend that read labels from one config, and keyboard navigation with a visible focus ring.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox whose check draws in, with indeterminate parents, groups and labels that share its hover.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A panel that shows and hides with height motion you can reverse mid-way, without jumping the layout.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A filterable select with chips, groups and async results, in a popup that resizes as you type.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list of actions, inline or as a ⌘K palette, with pages, shortcuts and highlighted matches.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: A menu of actions on right click or long press, with submenus, checkbox and radio items, and hold feedback on touch.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A table for real data, with sorting, search, row selection, pinned columns, a sticky header and pagination.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A button that opens a calendar in a popover, or a bottom sheet on phones, for single dates and ranges.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A window over the page for forms and focused tasks, with a pinned header and footer, nesting, and a swipeable bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge and follows your finger, with snap points, a working handle and nested drawers that stack.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu of actions and options behind a button, with groups, submenus, checkbox and radio items, and shortcuts.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A placeholder for screens with nothing to show yet, with an icon, a message and the next action.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Labels, descriptions and errors wired to their control, with validation states and layouts for forms.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: A preview card that opens when a link is hovered or focused, for content sighted users can glance at.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input with three sizes, invalid and read-only states, native validation styling and a 16px touch font so phones never zoom in.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: An input with icons, text, buttons or a keyboard hint attached, sharing one border and focus ring.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time code slots that take typing, paste and SMS autofill, with an opt-in animation that cascades codes in and a status for verifying.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row of media, text and actions for lists, settings and pickers, with a grouped surface and a hover highlight that glides between rows.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Key caps for shortcuts that show the right symbols on every platform, read them out properly and press down with the real keys.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A label that follows its control, dimming when it's disabled and marking it required or optional on its own.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Quiet notes between content, like date dividers and system events, with sticky dates and times that read as Today or Yesterday.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A desktop-style bar of menus with one highlight that slides between open menus and instant switching as you sweep across.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: A chat message row with an avatar, name, bubbles and status, where new messages rise in from the sender's side.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message scroller
items.description: A chat scroll area that follows new messages, keeps your place while you read back, and counts what you missed on the jump button.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native select
items.description: The browser's own select, styled to match Input, with a quiet placeholder, Field support and the OS picker on every device.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Site navigation with dropdowns, or one full-width panel that stays open while its content slides between menus.

items.name: number-flow
items.title: Number flow
items.description: Animated numbers where only the changed digits spin, with any Intl format and locale.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation that keeps every button in place, glides to the current page and jumps to any page from the ellipsis.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger that resizes smoothly with its content and follows the trigger’s direction.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A bar or ring that shows how far a task has come, eases between updates and slides while the total is unknown.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: A step-by-step form that moves between questions with a sense of direction, shows real progress and answers from the keyboard.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Pick one option from a set, with a dot that hands off between choices and cards whose selection ring slides to the new pick.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels you can drag apart, with a quiet divider that wakes up on hover, sizes that glide on reset or collapse, and layouts that persist.

items.name: safe-area
items.title: Safe area
items.description: A pointer safe triangle that keeps submenus and flyouts open while the cursor travels diagonally toward them.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: Native scrolling with a minimal scrollbar, edges that fade only where there’s more to see, and an optional peek that cuts the last item in half.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one or more options from a list that opens on the current value, with typeahead, groups and form support.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline that divides content horizontally or vertically, with an optional label and a decorative mode for purely visual lines.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge, with swipe-to-dismiss, scroll lock and stacked nesting.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: An app sidebar that collapses to icons or off canvas, stays pinned under your header, and becomes a swipeable sheet on phones.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholders that wait 150ms before showing, take the exact size of the content they wrap, and fade it in without moving anything.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a value or a range by dragging, tapping the track or using the keys, with jumps that glide and an optional value bubble.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A loading indicator with Apple-style ticks or a breathing ring that can wait before showing and stay long enough not to flicker.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off toggle you can tap, press or drag, with a thumb that stretches under your finger and an optional pending state for saves.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A responsive table with a surface style, wrapping or compact cells, sticky headers, pinned columns and scroll hints.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between views with an indicator that slides to the active tab, as a segmented control or an underline, and lists that scroll when they overflow.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text that grows smoothly with what you write between a minimum and maximum number of rows, with counters, validation and a submit shortcut.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: HextaUI design tokens: status colors, easing curves, hairline borders, type scale and the keyframes every component animates with.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief messages that stack neatly, expand on hover, swipe away, and turn a loading state into success or error in place.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays on or off, with a fill that settles in when pressed, a clear hover-to-on step and icons that can fill with the state.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A row of toggles for one choice or many, with a fill that slides to the picked item, joined or spaced items and arrow-key focus.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint on hover or keyboard focus that opens after a brief rest, switches instantly between neighbours and shows shortcuts.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: Nested, expandable rows for files and hierarchies, with indent guides, connector lines, cascading checkboxes, typeahead and full keyboard support.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video player
items.description: A video player with a scrubbable seek bar, auto-hiding controls, keyboard shortcuts, speed, picture in picture and full screen.
